alerts.title: Energy price shock
alerts.detail: Oil is +66% from a year ago (Nov 2026), feeding headline inflation and squeezing energy importers while lifting Canada's terms of trade.

alerts.title: Real wages falling in both countries
alerts.detail: Pay is trailing prices: real wage growth is −0.8% in Canada and −0.7% in the U.S. (Sep 2026), a drag on consumer spending.

alerts.title: Inflation above target
alerts.detail: Headline CPI is 4.0% in the U.S. and 3.1% in Canada, against 2% targets.

alerts.title: Credit spreads widening
alerts.detail: Corporate spreads are up +0.71 pts in three months to 3.42 points: lenders are pricing more default risk.

alerts.title: U.S. consumer sentiment depressed
alerts.detail: The University of Michigan index is 48.1 (Sep 2026), near historic lows.

alerts.title: Household inflation expectations elevated
alerts.detail: Consumers expect 4.0% inflation over the next year (Q3 2026), which can feed wage demands.
